verdict.rationale: Runway documents its own MCP server for connecting Runway to agents like Claude and ChatGPT, and a Dev MCP for Cursor, Claude Code and Codex, so users can drive it through natural-language agent conversations. Its pricing page also lists an "Agentic creative collaborator". All of these are one-line claims with no detail on which product operations can be commanded in plain language. Text-to-video prompting is content generation rather than operating the product, so it adds little here. missing for 10: documented scope of natural-language-controllable actions (editing, workflows, project management), detail on the agentic collaborator's command capabilities, hands-on or independent corroboration.
